# Yu Plugin Hub

Yu Plugin Hub 是 Yu 插件生态的文档、插件索引、统计与服务器展示站。

## Main Sections
- Plugins: /plugins/
- Guide: /guide/
- Security: /security/
- Servers: /servers/
- Stats: /stats/

## Plugin Index
- YuRelic: /plugins/items/yu-relic/
- YuPay: /plugins/items/yupay/
- Yu Auth: /plugins/items/yu-auth/
- Yu Protect: /plugins/items/yu-protect/
- Yu Market: /plugins/items/yu-market/

## Raw Data
- Plugin JSON: /data/plugins.json
- bStats JSON: /data/bstats.json
- Server Showcase JSON: /data/servers.json
